description: This file defines the TreeCompiler class used for compiling JMESPath expressions into executable PHP code within the JmesPath namespace.

classes.name: TreeCompiler
classes.description: A class responsible for compiling JMESPath expressions into PHP code strings, supporting nested expression nodes and code formatting.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Main method to generate PHP code from an AST, given a function name and expression string.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Internal method to invoke node-specific visit methods based on node type.

methods.name: makeVar
methods.description: Creates unique variable names with a given prefix to prevent naming conflicts.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Appends formatted code lines to the source string, managing indentation.

methods.name: outdent
methods.description: Reduces indentation level for proper code formatting.

methods.name: indent
methods.description: Increases indentation level for nested code blocks.

methods.name: visit_or
methods.description: Handles logical OR nodes in the expression AST.

methods.name: visit_and
methods.description: Handles logical AND nodes.

methods.name: visit_not
methods.description: Handles logical NOT nodes.

methods.name: visit_subexpression
methods.description: Handles subexpression nodes, generating nested expression code.

methods.name: visit_field
methods.description: Generates code for accessing object/array fields.

methods.name: visit_index
methods.description: Generates code for array index access.

methods.name: visit_literal
methods.description: Generates code for literal values.

methods.name: visit_pipe
methods.description: Handles pipe operation nodes, representing function chaining.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_list
methods.description: Delegates to visit_multi_select_hash for list selections.

methods.name: visit_multi_select_hash
methods.description: Generates code for multi-select hash constructs, creating associative arrays.

methods.name: visit_function
methods.description: Generates code for function call nodes using the Fd object.

methods.name: visit_slice
methods.description: Generates code for slice operations with start, end, and step.

methods.name: visit_current
methods.description: Handles current node, no operation needed.

methods.name: visit_expref
methods.description: Handles expression references, producing closures for recursive evaluations.

methods.name: visit_flatten
methods.description: Generates code to flatten nested arrays.

methods.name: visit_projection
methods.description: Generates code for projection operations over arrays or objects.

methods.name: visit_condition
methods.description: Generates code for conditional (if-else) expression nodes.

methods.name: visit_comparator
methods.description: Generates comparison logic for nodes with operators like ==, !=, >, <, etc.
